problem:
The population $P(t)$ of rabbits on a particular island follows the logistic growth model

$$
\frac{dP}{dt}=0.2P-0.0002{P}^{2},
$$

where $t$ is the time, measured in years. If there were $400$ rabbits on the island initially, how many rabbits inhabited the island after $3$ years? Round your answer to the nearest integer.

After $3$ years, approximately
{{field-1}} rabbits inhabited the island.
